title: Seymour's self-minor conjecture
exact_target: Can every infinite graph be obtained, up to isomorphism, by a nontrivial minor operation on itself, and does this at least hold for countably infinite graphs?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3297 (OPG-333). CC BY 4.0.
